summary:
Iteration 8 tested end-to-end (household shopping ×N, undo last meal change, lifestyle badges, current-week auto). Backend: 11 new iteration-8 tests + 92 regression = 103 passed, 1 xfail (documented snack-lifestyle bug) on the full /app/backend/tests suite (pytest_iter8.xml + pytest_all.xml). GET /api/programs/{id}/shopping/0?household=2 → household=2, raw_grams of each shared food_id is exactly 2× the household=1 value (±5 g rounding tolerance) across all sections; text field starts with '🛒 Courses — Semaine 1' and appends ' (×2 personnes)' when household>1; missing param defaults to 1; household=7 → 422 (Query(ge=1, le=6)). POST /meals/action {action:'replace', week:0, day:3, meal:'lunch'} → 200, can_undo=true; following {action:'undo'} → 200, message '↩ Dernière modification annulée.', day.meals.lunch.recipe.name == pre-replace name (verified via a fresh GET /programs/current), can_undo=false; second immediate undo → 400 'Rien à annuler.'; after a replace + undo cycle, an {action:'done'} does NOT re-open the undo (can_undo stays false — confirmed doc.undo is cleared on undo and 'done' never writes a snapshot). GET /programs/current — every non-snack meal.recipe has a 'lifestyle' list with values ∈ {Sans cuisson, Sans four, À emporter, Air fryer OK}; at least one non-empty. Frontend (390x844, testuser1@test.fr / testpass123, 0 JS pageerror): (1) Shopping — chips household-1/household-2/household-4 all visible; clicking household-2 doubles the first item on the list (Abricots: 130 g → 260 g); share-shopping click (with stubbed navigator.clipboard.writeText + navigator.share) captures a text starting with '🛒 Courses — Semaine 1 (×2 personnes)' followed by the FRUITS & LÉGUMES section. (2) Planner — row-replace-lunch click swaps the lunch and reveals undo-button; clicking undo-button restores the original recipe name in meal-row-lunch and hides undo-button. (3) Recipe — after clicking recipe-replace on /recipe?week=0&day=0&meal=lunch, three lifestyle badges appear (lifestyle-Sans cuisson '🥗 Sans cuisson', lifestyle-Sans four '🍳 Sans four', lifestyle-À emporter '🥡 À emporter'); recipe-undo is visible and clicking it hides the button. (4) currentWeekIndex(program) is wired in both /shopping (line 73) and /planner (line 78-81) — auto-selects the current week from program.created_at.

KNOWN BUG (xfailed): snack recipes (engine.py:490 build_snack) are built inline as a dict literal and DO NOT include the 'lifestyle' key, while spec asks 'chaque meal.recipe possède lifestyle (liste, éventuellement vide)'. Only main meals and breakfast (which flow through make_recipe engine.py:224-241) get the lifestyle badges. Impact: on the frontend recipe screen for a snack, no lifestyle badges will render (safe due to `r.lifestyle ?? []` at recipe.tsx:283). Fix: route snack through make_recipe or add a lifestyle=['Sans cuisson','Sans four','À emporter'] literal to the inline snack dict.

minor.issue: engine.py:490 build_snack constructs the recipe dict inline and omits the 'lifestyle' key; spec requires every meal.recipe to expose lifestyle (possibly empty). Frontend renders nothing (safe via ?? []) but breaks parity. Fix: add lifestyle=['Sans cuisson','Sans four','À emporter'] literal or route snack through make_recipe.

action_items: engine.py:490 — add 'lifestyle': ['Sans cuisson','Sans four','À emporter'] to the inline snack recipe dict (or refactor build_snack to reuse make_recipe with a snack-specific blueprint), so that GET /programs/current is fully consistent across all meals.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:397 shopping route declares household: int = Query(1, ge=1, le=6) — spec asks household=7 → 422 which is served natively by FastAPI validation, matches exactly. Response text line 402 conditionally adds ' (×N personnes)' only when household>1 — nice UX and matches the frontend expectation.

engine.py:562 shopping_for_week applies `household` on the aggregation (`it['cooked'] += c['grams'] * household`, `it['raw'] += c['grams'] * f['raw'] * household`) BEFORE rounding — so raw_grams is exactly 2× the base with only the ±5g rounding difference. Home items also scale by household. Clean.

server.py:446-452 undo handler pulls the snapshot from doc.undo, replaces the entire day (weeks[snap['week']]['days'][snap['day']] = snap['day_data']), atomically clears doc.undo via $set undo:None and returns can_undo:false. Correct.

server.py:454 snapshot creation is gated on action ∈ {'replace','quick','replace_component','set_component','swap_day'} — meaning 'done', 'outside', 'favorite', 'rating' actions correctly do NOT reset the undo history nor create a new one. But note: they also don't CLEAR the existing undo, so the last replace remains undoable across a 'done'. Line 514's `can_undo: bool(snapshot or doc.get('undo'))` — because `doc` is re-fetched fresh at the start of each request, `doc.get('undo')` reflects the DB state, so a 'done' following an 'undo' correctly reports can_undo=false (undo already cleared).

engine.py:227-235 make_recipe assigns lifestyle badges based on the blueprint.method: 'Sans cuisson' for bowl-style/toast/overnight/smoothie/etc., 'Sans four' for anything not oven/roast/gratin/quiche/etc., 'À emporter' for bowl/sandwich/toast/frittata/quiche/overnight/verrine, 'Air fryer OK' for oven/roast/skewers/croquettes/meatballs/stuffed/gratin. Deterministic per blueprint, matches spec allowed set exactly {Sans cuisson, Sans four, À emporter, Air fryer OK}.
engine.py:490 SNACK BUG — the snack recipe dict literal misses the 'lifestyle' key; every other recipe factory goes through make_recipe which sets it. This is a parity miss with the site.

program-store.tsx:17-23 currentWeekIndex computes the current week from program.created_at by aligning to the Monday of the creation week (getDay()+6)%7 → correct European week convention; clamps to [0, weeks.length-1]. Used in both shopping.tsx:73 and planner.tsx:78-81 via `if (program && !autoWeek) { setAutoWeek(true); setWeek(currentWeekIndex(program)); }` — the autoWeek guard prevents overriding the user's manual selection on later renders. Clean pattern.

shopping.tsx:159-163 household chips (household-1/2/4) + shareBtn (share-shopping) share the same header row; onPress uses navigator.share when available and falls back to clipboard.writeText — matches the browser test where stubbing either API captured the payload. shopping.tsx:83 passes ?household=<n> which triggers the useEffect re-fetch on state change.

planner.tsx:237 undo-button rendered inline in the day header (marginRight:6) next to swap-day; disabled during busy state — prevents double-clicks. mealAction(week,dayIdx,'lunch','undo') is fine even though 'lunch' is a placeholder (the backend ignores meal on undo, uses the snapshot's own week/day).
recipe.tsx:283 lifestyle badges rendered via (r.lifestyle ?? []).map — safe for legacy meals or snacks missing the field; each badge gets testID=`lifestyle-<name>` making them assertable.

success_rate.backend: 100% for tested behaviour (11 new iteration-8 tests + 92 regression = 103 passed on the full /app/backend/tests suite). 1 xfailed test documents the snack-lifestyle field bug — expected failure, not a regression.
success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows on 390x844 web preview: shopping household chips (Pour moi / ×2 / ×4), quantity doubling on household=2 (Abricots 130 g → 260 g), share-shopping publishes text starting with '🛒 Courses — Semaine 1 (×2 personnes)', planner row-replace-lunch → undo-button appears → click restores original lunch → undo-button disappears, recipe screen shows 3 lifestyle badges (🥗 Sans cuisson, 🍳 Sans four, 🥡 À emporter) after recipe-replace on a fresh meal, recipe-undo visible and functional. 0 JS pageerror across shopping / planner / recipe.

seed_data_creation: Iteration-8 backend tests self-sign-up disposable users (test_it8_<uuid>@test.fr) and generate their own programs — fully isolated. Frontend testing used testuser1@test.fr on the existing program (created before lifestyle feature landed, hence bare recipes with lifestyle=[] until a replace regenerates them); the browser test performed 2 replaces on w0d0 lunch (one to check undo, one to expose lifestyle badges) — reversible via recipe-undo (validated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 endpoints: GET /api/programs/{id}/shopping/{w}?household=N (1..6, 422 outside), response has 'household' + 'text' fields; text = '🛒 Courses — Semaine {w+1} (×N personnes)' + sections; raw_grams scales by N linearly. POST /meals/action {action:'undo', week:..., day:..., meal:...} — meal param is ignored (undo restores the whole day from doc.undo snapshot); message '↩ Dernière modification annulée.'; 400 'Rien à annuler.' when doc.undo is falsy. Snapshot is only created for actions ∈ {replace, quick, replace_component, set_component, swap_day}; 'done'/'outside'/'favorite'/'rating' preserve the existing undo without touching it. Recipe.lifestyle list ∈ {Sans cuisson, Sans four, À emporter, Air fryer OK} deterministic from blueprint.method (engine.py:227-235). KNOWN BUG: snack recipes (build_snack engine.py:490) DO NOT include 'lifestyle' — main agent should either add a literal or route through make_recipe. currentWeekIndex(program) (program-store.tsx:17) computes from program.created_at; used in shopping/planner with an autoWeek latch. Frontend testIDs (iter8): shopping.tsx — household-1/household-2/household-4, share-shopping, shop-item-<food_id>, shop-week-<i>. planner.tsx — undo-button (only visible when server returned can_undo=true), row-replace-<meal>, meal-row-<meal>, swap-day. recipe.tsx — lifestyle-<label> (only rendered when r.lifestyle non-empty), recipe-undo, recipe-replace, recipe-quick.
rca_of_issue: Snack lifestyle bug — RCA: engine.py:470-492 build_snack constructs the recipe dict as a literal (fields blueprint_id/name/method/image/steps/minutes/difficulty/difficulty_label/extras/quick/moods/mode) without the 'lifestyle' key added by make_recipe (engine.py:228-235). Reproduction: fresh signup + POST /programs/generate + GET /programs/current → any day's meals.snack.recipe has no 'lifestyle' key (KeyError on strict access). Mitigation: add `lifestyle: ['Sans cuisson', 'Sans four', 'À emporter']` (all three trivially apply to snacks) to the inline dict, OR wrap the snack build via a lightweight blueprint + make_recipe. Frontend is already tolerant thanks to `r.lifestyle ?? []` (recipe.tsx:283).
